int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    int T = 1;
    const long long MOD = 1000000007;

    while (T--) {
        int total_points, factor;
        cin >> total_points >> factor;
        vector<int> sequence(total_points);
        for (int i = 0; i < total_points; ++i) {
            sequence[i] = (long long)factor * i % total_points;
        }

        if (factor == 0) {
            long long answer = 1;
            for (int i = 0; i < total_points; ++i) {
                answer = (answer * i) % MOD;
            }
            answer = pow(total_points, total_points - 1, MOD);
            cout << answer << "\n";
            continue;
        }

        vector<bool> visited_nodes(total_points, false);
        vector<int> cycle_counts(total_points, 0);
        long long result = 1;

        for (int start_node = 0; start_node < total_points; ++start_node) {
            if (visited_nodes[start_node]) continue;
            int cycle_length = 0;
            int current_node = start_node;
            while (!visited_nodes[current_node]) {
                visited_nodes[current_node] = true;
                current_node = sequence[current_node];
                cycle_length++;
            }
            cycle_counts[cycle_length]++;

                    e >>= 1;

}
